newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila stocks property sub-index soars by midtrade.
newsitem.headline: Manila stocks property sub-index soars by midtrade.

text.p: Philippine property stocks rose by midtrade on Thursday on bargain hunting by foreign funds, brokers said.
The property sub-index at the Philippine Stock Exchange was up 4.01 percent to 150.21 points after one hour of trading.

"Foreign funds bought back shares which have no or little exposure in high-end property developments like office condominiums," said Henry Ong, analyst at Sapphire Securities, adding that perceptions had developed that the top end of the real estate sector was too crowded.
Other brokers said investors picked up property issues that had reached bargain levels. Property issues have borne the brunt of the stock market's correction in the last two weeks.
Among the gainers were SM Prime, up 50 centavos to 5.90 pesos, Filinvest Land, up 60 centavos to 9.20 pesos, and Ayala Land B, up 1.50 pesos to 28.50.
